table.title: Monthly and Annual Temperature Means in Centigrade, 1947
transcriber_notes: Rows: 86 as printed (62 stations + 24 province sub-heading rows): p. 11 20 stations, p. 12 21, p. 13 21. Printed sideways on each page; read from rotated crops.
No totals printed. Annual Average is not re-computed (several months missing for some stations).
'..' as printed for missing figures. Minus signs transcribed as '−'.

On p. 12 the figures in the right-hand columns (July–Annual Average) are printed progressively lower than their row labels; assigned in order within each province group (counts of labels and figure lines match).
On pp. 11 (Ningsia) and 12 the '..' entries sit slightly out of line; assigned in order within the group.
Chungwei, Aug.: '23.7' — the final 7 is damaged type but reads as 7.
Chinkiang, May: '18.7' — ink blot over the lower loop of the 8; upper loop clear.
As printed, possibly misprints: Tulan Dec. '8.2' (no minus sign; Nov. '..'); Taipei Dec. '20.5'; Tainan Annual Average '12.9' (monthly figures 14.4–28.0).

table.title: Monthly and Annual Precipitation Means, in Mm., 1947
footnotes: Remark: "T" stands for "Trace," indicating precipitation less than 1 mm.
transcriber_notes: Printed sideways across pp. 14-16 (p. 14 on leaf p1-0018 left, p. 15 on p1-0018 right, p. 16 on p1-0019 left); pp. 15-16 headed 'Table 7.—Continued'.
Rows: 62 stations under 24 province sub-heading rows (p. 14: 20 stations, p. 15: 20, p. 16: 21). Province names printed as sub-headings are kept as rows with empty cells.
'..' is printed in cells with no data; kept as printed. 'T' = trace.
Row 'Yulin': the 'u' of the station name is damaged/filled in the print; read as Yulin.
Row 'Soochow', col 'Sept.': broken type, final digit unreadable (looks like 27.9 or 27.8); left blank. Annual Average 945.6 would imply 27.8.

Annual Average checked against the sum of the 12 months (T and '..' counted as 0): reconciles for 51 of the 61 stations. Does NOT reconcile: Tsingtao sum 863.8 vs printed 863.6 (diff 0.2); Pingliang sum 697.8 vs 697.9 (diff 0.1, Feb. is T); Changsha sum 1092.6 vs 1088.6 (diff 4.0); Hofei sum 874.8 vs 874.5 (diff 0.3). Cells in these rows re-read; transcribed as printed. Not checkable: Changchun, Chengteh, Kalgan, Tulan, Kunming, Tsunyi (annual printed '..'); Soochow (blank cell).
No total row printed.
